title: Germany – Tanks, reservoirs, containers and pressure vessels – RV über die Herstellung und Lieferung von bis zu 3.700 Tankcontainern Kraftstoffe (TCK) 9 m³
description: Es wird beabsichtigt, eine Rahmenvereinbarung (RV) mit einem Unternehmen über die Herstellung und Lieferung von bis zu 3.700 Tankcontainern Kraftstoffe (TCK) 9 m³ zu schließen inklusive Sonderwerkzeugsatz, Mess- und Prüfmittel, Ersatzteilerstbedarf, Einsatzvorrat an Ersatz- und Austauschteilen (ET/ AT) 30 Tage Landesverteidigung/ Bündnisverteidigung (LV/BV), Dokumentation inklusive nachbaufähigen Zeichnungsunterlagen sowie Erstausbildung von Ausbildungs- und Instandsetzungspersonal und Unterstützungsleistungen. Es ist eine Gesamtvergabe vorgesehen. Die Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung soll 15 Jahre betragen. Bei den TCK 9 m³ handelt es sich um eine Gefahrgutum-schließung, die der Lagerung, dem Transport und Umschlag von Kraftstoffen dient. Im Verbund mit geeigneten Mobilitätsträgern (geländegängige vierachsige-Lastkraftwagen der Zuladungs-klasse 15 t, mit ADR- Zulassung und Twist-Lock-Aufnahme und / oder Hakenliftsystem) dient der TCK 9 m³ zur Versorgung von Endverbrauchern in urbanen und schwer zugänglichen Geländeabschnitten mit Kraftstoffen unter gleichzeitiger Einhaltung aller umweltrechtlichen Auflagen. Der TCK 9 m³ kann sowohl im aufgesetzten (auf Lkw) als auch im abgesetzten Betrieb (als autarkes Stand-Alone-Gerät) betrieben werden. Der TCK 9 m³ besteht aus einem doppelwandigem Tankkörper, einer Kraftstoffpumpanlage mit zwei Abgabeeinrichtungen, einem Stromerzeugeraggregat, sowie der rechtlich vorgeschriebenen Gefahrgutausstattung, die in einem 20 Fuß-ISO-Rahmen integriert ist. Bei Vertragsschluss sollen 602 EA fest beauftragt werden. Es ist ein Vorseriengerät TCK 9 m³ zu liefern. Die Lieferung des Vorseriengeräts TCK 9 m³ ist innerhalb von 9 Monaten nach Vertragsschluss zur Durchführung der Integrierten Nachweisführung vorgesehen. Zudem wird in der Rahmenvereinbarung die Lieferung folgender Leistungen vereinbart: - Muster-Sonderwerkzeugsatz - Ersatzteilerstbedarf - Einsatzvorrat an Ersatz- und Austauschteilen (ET/AT) LV/BV (30 Tage) - notwendige Mess- und Prüfmittel - Materialgrundlagen; hierzu zählen Sicherheitsdatenblätter, Stücklisten, nachbaufähige Zeichnungsunterlagen, Artikelstammdaten, Interaktive Elektronische Technische Dokumentation - Ausbildungsunterlagen - Prüf-/Abnahmedokumentation - Managementleistungen - Personalausbildung - Begleitung der Integrierten Nachweisführung Die TCK 9 m³ müssen für den Bundeswehr-Einsatz im Wesentlichen die nachfolgenden Forderungen erfüllen. Diese Übersicht dient dabei nur einer ersten Projektvorstellung. Die genauen Spezifikationen werden den Bietern nach erfolgreichem Nachweis der Eignung und Zulassung zur Angebotsphase übermittelt: - Kraftstoffnutzvolumen Tankkörper mindestens 9.000 Liter - Zulässige Gesamtmasse: 15.000 Kilogramm - Länge/Breite/Höhe: 20 Fuss / 8 Fuss / kleiner gleich 8 Fuss - Doppelwandiger Tankkörper mit Leckageüberwachung - Integrierte Kraftstoffpumpanlage mit zwei Abgabeeinrichtungen und einer Schlauchlänge von jeweils 20 Metern - Volumenstrom an den beiden Abgabeeinrichtungen mindestens 120 Liter pro Minute bei gleichzeitiger Abgabe -Befüll-/Entleeranschluss über 3 Zoll Industrietrockenkupplung gemäß STANAG 3756 - Uneingeschränkte Transportierbarkeit per Land-, Schienen- und Seeweg im befüllten Zustand - Transport-/Umschlagmöglichkeit mit in der Bundeswehr eingeführten Trägerfahrzeuge (20 Fuß Twist-Locks und/oder LKW mit Hakenliftsystem nach DIN 30722-2) - Zulassung für den Transport und Umschlag der Kraftstoffe F-34, F-35, F-63, F-75, F-44 und handelsüblicher Dieselkraftstoff nach DIN EN 590 bzw. F54 - uneingeschränkter Einsatz in Gebieten der Klimazonen A1 bis A3, B1 bis B3, C0 bis C1 gemäß STANAG 4370 i. V. m. Tampereen kaupunki valmistelee hankintaa PIKI-kirjastojen yhteistoiminta-sopimuksen mukaisesti. Kyseessä on usean toimittajan puitejärjestely. Hankinta on jaettu suomenkielisen ja muunkielisen kirjallisuuden osa-alueisiin. Kuhunkin osa-alueeseen valitaan viisi (5) toimittajaa tarjousten vertailussa muodostuvan etusijajärjestyksen mukaisesti. Mikäli osa-alueella on vähemmän kuin viisi (5) soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävää tarjoajaa tai hyväksyttävää tarjousta, puitejärjestelyyn valitaan kaikki kyseisen osa-alueen soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttäneet tarjoajat, jotka ovat jättäneet tarjouspyynnön mukaisen hyväksyttävän tarjouksen. . Kokonaistaloudellisen edullisuuden perusteet (arviointikriteerit) on esitetty tässä tarjouspyynnössä liitteessä Vertailukriteerit. Sopimuskaudella hankinta tapahtuu pääosin hankintaportaalin kautta; portaali vertailee kunkin yksittäisen hankinnan hintoja ja ohjaa tilauksen sille toimittajalle, joka tarjoaa sen edullisimpaan hintaan., Suomenkielinen kirjallisuus Suomenkielisessä kirjallisuuden osa-alueessa tarjonnan tulee yleisen kirjallisuuden lisäksi sisältää laaja valikoima julkisten organisaatioiden, erilaisten yritysten ja yhdistysten ja muiden pien- ja omakustantajien tuotantoa. Lisäksi tulee tarjota kotimaisia nuotteja ja karttoja., Muunkielinen kirjallisuus Muunkielinen kirjallisuus on muuta kuin suomenkielistä ja Suomessa kustannettua kirjallisuutta. Muunkielisessä kirjallisuudessa tarjonnan tulee olla riittävän laaja ja monipuolinen. Tilaajalla on halutessaan oikeus hankkia ulkomaisia nuotteja ja karttoja sopimuksen kautta.,

Tilaaja ilmoittaa Toimittajalle option käyttämisestä viimeistään kolme (3) kuukautta ennen varsinaisen sopimuskauden tai ensimmäisen optiokauden päättymistä. The Contractor will perform required maintenance to ensure facilities, associated systems, vehicles, and equipment remain operational to meet the base mission. The Contractor will comply with environmental protection, safety, and security directives. The Contractor will conduct required training to ensure personnel are fully qualified to perform Performance Work Statement (PWS) tasks. The Contractor shall conduct all necessary fuels operations to support base operations, airshows and special events, deployments, exercises, and contingencies under normal conditions, as well as, during periods of heightened security, inclement weather, or other unique situations. The Contractor shall operate and maintain the self-service automated service station facilities, equipment, and systems and ensure sufficient product is available to provide 24 hours a day, seven days a week support of ground fuels. The Contractor shall perform required tasks to ensure fuel is properly accounted for and issued to only authorized users. This procurement will be 100% set aside for Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Business (SDVOSB) under NAICS code 493190 (Other Warehouse and Storage). The Government anticipates issuing one solicitation and awarding four (4) firm fixed-price contracts for Cannon AFB, NM, Holloman AFB, NM, Davis Monthan AFB, AZ, and Luke AFB, AZ. These requirements will be for a four-year base period (December 01, 2026 � November 30, 2030), a five-year option period (December 01, 2030 � November 30, 2035), and a option to extend the contract s for up to six individual months (December 01, 2035 � May 31, 2036).This procurement will be solicited under full and open competition after exclusion of sources. title: Access Control and Intrusion Detection Services
description: The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) requires the provision of parts and labour (technical support, programming, installation, service, and maintenance) on an “as and when requested” basis for its Integrated Security System (ISS) at CRA locations across Canada. The CRA is considering the conversion of up to 51 sites currently using a combination of Digital Security Controls (DSC) Intrusion Detection Systems and Kantech Access Control systems to a unified Kantech Intrusion/Access Control platform. The site counts identified below represent the CRA’s current intended conversion plans for planning and estimation purposes only and do not constitute a commitment to convert any specific number of sites. The CRA requires the goods and services referenced above in the following regions: 1. National Capital Region (NCR) – up to 11 sites identified for potential conversion; 2. Ontario – up to 13 sites identified for potential conversion; 3. Quebec – up to 1 site identified for potential conversion; 4. Atlantic – up to 4 sites identified for potential conversion; and 5. Western – up to 22 sites identified for potential conversion. Bidders may submit a bid for one (1) or more Regions identified in this RFP. Only one (1) bid submission is required, regardless of the number of Regions for which the Bidder is submitting a bid. The Bidder's submission must clearly identify each Region for which it is proposing to provide the required goods and services. For each Region bid, the Bidder must provide all information required by this RFP, including any Region-specific technical information, resource information, and pricing, in the format prescribed in the bid solicitation documents. Requirement, project experience, certification, corporate qualification, or other bid components that are not Region-specific need only be submitted once and will be evaluated for all Regions included in the Bidder's submission. Bids for Multiple Regions: Requirements identified as Region-specific will be evaluated only for the applicable Region. Requirements that are not Region-specific will be evaluated once and will apply to all Regions included in the Bidder's submission. The CRA will evaluate each Region independently. Where a Bidder fails to meet a Region-specific requirement, the CRA may declare the bid non-responsive for that Region only. For greater certainty, a determination that a bid is non-responsive for one (1) Region will not, in itself, render the Bidder's submission non-responsive for any other Region for which a bid as been submitted, provided all applicable requirements for those Regions are met. The CRA intends to award up to five (5) contracts to fulfill this requirement. A Bidder may be awarded a contract for one (1) Region, multiple Regions, or all five (5) Regions. The period of the resulting contract(s) will be for three (3) firm years. The contract(s) will include four (4) irrevocable one-year options to extend the period of the contract(s). The contract(s) will also include provisions allowing the CRA to add, remove or modify products and sites. A bid must comply with the requirements of the bid solicitation and meet all mandatory evaluation criteria to be declared responsive. For each Region, the responsive bid with the highest combined rating of technical merit and price will be recommended for award of a contract. Each Region will be evaluated separately. Where the same Bidder is ranked first for multiple Regions, the CRA will award a single contract covering the Regions for which that Bidder is the highest-ranked responsive bidder. The Bid Compliance and Remedy Process (BCRP) defined in Part 4.2 will apply. Proposal documents and supporting information must be submitted in either English or French. Bidders must not use their own licensing agreement for Connect to initiate a Connect conversation with CRA. The CRA reserves the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. There are security requirements associated with this requirement. For additional information, consult the bid solicitation document. title: Purchase of One (1) Liquid Chromatography System
description: Tendering Procedures: Invitation to tenders following instructions on the Supply Arrangement Competitive Procurement Strategy: Contract against the SA will be awarded to the supplier responding to all mandatory technical criteria and with the lowest price. Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: No Nature of Requirements: Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, SA E60PV-19EQUI for the purchase of : One (1) Liquid Chromatography System Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada, Kentville Research and Development Centre THIS REQUEST IS RESERVED FOR HOLDERS OF SUPPLY ARRANGEMENT # E60PV-19EQUI ONLY, FOR THE PURCHASE OF LABORATORY AND SCIENTIFIC EQUIPMENT, PARTS AND ACCESSORIES, SERVICES AND SUPPLIES. Only Suppliers currently pre-qualified on Supply Arrangement E60PV-19EQUI have been invited to bid. As a requirement of the Supply Arrangement, this notice is published on Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) for a period of 40 calendar days. The closing date published on this notice identifies how long the notice will be published. For the closing date of any solicitation under the supply arrangement, invited suppliers should refer to the solicitation documents. Suppliers that do not have a Supply Arrangement for the supply of Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies with Public Works and Government Services Canada, cannot submit a bid. Any bids received from suppliers not pre-qualified on the Supply Arrangement will not be evaluated. Suppliers may qualify under Supply Arrangement E60PV-19EQUI for Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies, at any time. Interested suppliers should download solicitation document E60PV-19EQUI/D from CanadaBuys (SAP Ariba) and submit a response as per the requirements of the Request for Supply Arrangement. The responsive bidder already holding a Supply arrangement for Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies from Public Works and Government Services Canada who meets the mandatory technical criteria with the lowest aggregate price will be recommended for contract award. The mandatory technical criteria are: Liquid Chromatography (LC) System a. The LC system must be supplied with an LC solution suitable for proteomics, such as a nano-flow LC system for peptide sample preparation and separation, designed for seamless coupling to the MS. The system must operate at flow rates ranging from at least 200 nL/min to 100 µL/min and must not require a flow splitter. b. The LC system must have the maximum operating pressure at least to 15,000 psi. c. The LC system must be capable of operating within a pH range of 2–10. d. The LC system must support two-dimensional (2D) LC analysis, including an auxiliary solvent and trap valve manager, a column-trapping pump, nano-Lock spray capability, primary check valves, column compartment, and switching valves configured for 2D operation. All primary wetted materials must be included. e. The LC system must support unattended operation, with full diagnostic data display for up to 96 hours through the control software. f. The LC system must include solvent storage, with a solvent tray capable of accommodating up to three (3) eluents. g. The LC system must include a micro-binary solvent delivery system, supporting solvents A1 or A2 and B1 or B2, and must provide solvent conditioning, gradient formation, primary check valves, compressibility compensation, and automatic priming. Pump compositional precision must be < 0.25% RSD based on repeated injections. The system must be equipped with an integrated, programmable active wash system to flush the rear of the high-pressure seals. h. The LC system must include a sample handling system with an injection volume range from 0.1 µL to 100 µL, with 5 µL standard injection, supporting 1, 2, 5, 20, 50, and 100 µL injection options, and unlimited volume for trapping. The system must have full-loop and partial-loop injection modes. The autosampler must accommodate 96- or 48-position sample plates with 2.0 mL vials and include a temperature-controlled autosampler (4.0–40.0 °C) with high temperature accuracy and stability. The system must have a column chamber (temperature controlled). i. All equipment must be certified or approved for use in accordance with the Canadian Electrical Code; j. description: Deze opdracht heeft betrekking op de ontwikkeling, levering en installatie van een onderzoeksgericht windgeneratiesysteem voor het Coastal & Ocean Basin Oostende Het Coastal & Ocean Basin (COB) is gevestigd in het Maritiem Onderzoekscentrum van de Vlaamse Overheid in Oostende (UGent Ostend Science Park). Het is ontworpen om het effect van golven en stromingen op kustwaterbouwkundige constructies en offshore/drijvende installaties te bestuderen, zoals het nieuwe energie-eiland in de Noordzee of op de natuur gebaseerde oplossingen voor erosiebescherming rond de fundering van offshore windturbines.
